title: 第7章  狡猾妖女，故人许灵溪
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
李寒山一直觉得，做人要有边界感，所以对丫头的身份，他从未问过。或许也正是因为这份克制，双方才能够在梦境中交谈甚欢，成了忘年交。
在体会过阳册的神奇后，再加上这远古术法，让他觉得，丫头的身份一定不简单，修为恐怕也不低。
少说是筑基，也有概率是金丹，甚至更厉害的元婴大能，也未必不可能。
“要是丫头能找到合欢宗就好了。”李寒山不由奢望。
丫头若真是大能，找上合欢宗把他救走，以后他跟着丫头混，吃香的喝辣的，那日子，别提多舒坦了。
奢望终究只能是奢望，现在的他，只能面对冷冰冰的现实。好在这现实虽冷，总归还有花弄影那火热的身子可以抚慰一下。
只是，第二天他便发现了一件不妙的事。
花弄影不见了！
“主人，仙子出去办事了，这是她留给主人的。”
李寒山找到两个婢女一问，得知了花弄影的动向，还得到了一张纸条。
他展开纸条，上面写着几行娟秀的字：
“主人：奴家见您睡得正香，不忍吵醒。此去为主人寻些延年益寿、强身健体的灵丹妙药，顺便也为自己的筑基做些准备。主人放心，奴家去去就回。对了，奴家不在时，主人尽量不要乱走。宗里有些家伙，可不怎么守规矩呢。——弄影.留”
李寒山看完了字，脸色沉了下去，他有种预感，花弄影短时间内应该不会回来了。
足足过了七天，她都没有回来。
“这妖女真狡猾！”
李寒山愁眉不展，花弄影这一招让他有些无解。
因为她像这样离开，并不算违背心魔誓言。
而在她离开后，他就没办法继续借助她来提升修为了，同时花弄影也可以避免被吸，从而去采用别的手段筑基。
而一旦她筑基，再不受心魔誓言的束缚，那就是李寒山真正的末日。
“不行，不能这样干等下去。”

李寒山决定做点什么，不能守在这里等死。
好在当初反杀这妖女后，她身上灵石之类的修炼资源被他据为己有。后面为了安抚她，李寒山又还了她大半，但自己也还留有不少，这些还在他身上，用一个储物袋装着。
李寒山将所有的修炼资源全部装好，又找婢女要了一些食物后，便径直出了门，沿着一条小径往外走去。
“内门住山上，外门住山下，我这样一直走，应该可以走到外门弟子的区域，再找个合适的妖女来修炼。”
这是他的计划。
靠自己修炼是不现实的，根本不可能追上花弄影。
如今之计，只能再找个妖女，然后借助阳册修炼。
只是这妖女的人选必须寻好，修为不能太高，否则就有可能脱离掌控，甚至暴露他的秘密。
至于逃出合欢宗，仍不在他的考虑之中，炉鼎的身份在这里，连护山大阵这一关都过不了，怎么逃?
合欢宗极大，李寒山走了小半个时辰，才走到一处开阔的地方。前方视野豁然开朗，可以看到一排排建筑沿着山势修筑而成，那应该是外门弟子居住的区域。
“那里应该是集市。”
李寒山在众多建筑的中间，看到了一个人声鼎沸的宗门集市。想了想，他决定去集市上碰一碰。于是便沿大路下到山脚，一入集市后，眼前陡然热闹起来。
“咦？你们看那个老头——”
“那不是黑市那个先天纯阳圣体吗？居然还没死？”
“不会吧？花师姐的性子什么时候这么温柔了？她之前那些炉鼎，最长的不也就撑了三天？”
几个衣着清凉的妖女凑在一起，冲着李寒山指指点点。
其中又一个生得狐媚的女子听到“先天纯阳圣体”三个字，眼珠一转，扭着水蛇腰就朝李寒山走来。
“这位老伯～”狐媚女子娇滴滴地开口，“你怎么一个人在这儿呀？要不跟妹妹走？妹妹保证让你舒舒服服的～”
她说着，伸出纤纤玉指，就要去勾李寒山的下巴。
李寒山垂眼看着那根手指，默默感应着对方的气息。

这妖女虽有几分本钱，但跟花弄影差远了，经历了花弄影那种级别的妖娆，再看这种货色，简直索然无味。但若是能借助她修炼，他还是能忍一忍的。
“别闹！”
旁边一个绿衣女子急忙拉住她，压低声音：“你疯了？花弄影师姐的炉鼎你也敢沾？不要命了？”
狐媚女子听到“花弄影”三个字，脸色一白，连忙收回手，讪讪地看了李寒山一眼，转身就走。
“花弄影的名头这么吓人？”
李寒山脸色一沉，如果是这样，那事情就不好办了。因为这些外门弟子没人敢碰花弄影的炉鼎！那些敢碰的，对他来说又太危险了。
他没有气馁，继续在集市中逛了起来。
认出他的妖女还不少，毕竟一百岁的老头子，在合欢宗着实太少见了一点，这一带又是外门区域，许多妖女都在地下黑市中见过他。
除了最开始的狐媚女子外，也有其它妖女前来撩他，但都在得知他是花弄影的炉鼎后识趣地离开了。
“怎么就没一个胆子大一点的呢！我可是先天纯阳圣体啊，撑死胆大的，饿死胆小的，这都不懂？”
李寒山有些无语。
转着转着，天要黑了，集市上的人少了起来。
“孙师兄，别这样。”
“做我的道侣，对你来说可是天大的造化，这是我在帮你，否则，再有十天，你就会沦为炉鼎，到那时我再把你买下，就不是现在这个态度了！”
争吵声传来。
李寒山循声望去，只见几个年轻弟子正围成一圈，中间站着一个穿着合欢宗弟子服的小姑娘。
她多次尝试都冲不出去，一张小脸涨得通红，又急又气。
“许灵溪？”李寒山愣了一下。
许灵溪跟他是一个村子的，这孩子心善，李寒山穿越过来后，经常缺衣少食，还多亏了她们一家的接济，否则很可能活不到现在。
看样子这次合欢宗抓人，连她也没放过。

“孙师兄，求求您放过我吧......”许灵溪要哭了。
“许师妹，我好话说尽，你还不识抬举，这是逼我动手啊。”
孙师兄不耐烦了，要上手去抓许灵溪。
“住手！”
一个苍老的声音，从旁边响起。
孙师兄一愣，转头看去。
只见一个须发花白的老头子正慢慢走过来，腰背微微佝偻，脸上皱纹不少，但一双眼睛却亮得惊人。“哪儿来的老东西？”
孙泽上打量了李寒山一眼，嗤笑道，“一把老骨头了还学人家英雄救美？滚一边去！”
李寒山不恼不怒，平静道：“她不想跟你，何必强人所难？”
“哟呵？”孙泽乐了，回头看了两个跟班一眼，“哥几个听见没有？这老东西居然敢管我的事？”
content_en:
Li Hanshan always felt that a person should have a sense of boundaries, so he never asked about the girl's identity. Perhaps it was precisely because of this restraint that the two parties were able to have a happy conversation in the dream and became friends forever.
After experiencing the magic of Yang Book, coupled with this ancient magic, he felt that the girl's identity must not be simple, and her cultivation level may not be low.
It is less likely to be a foundation building, and it is also possible to be a golden elixir, or even a more powerful Nascent Soul power, which may not be impossible.
"It would be great if this girl could find the Hehuan Sect." Li Hanshan couldn't help but hope.
If the girl is really powerful, she goes to the Hehuan Sect to rescue him. From now on, he hangs out with the girl, eating well and drinking spicy food. That life will be extremely comfortable.
Extravagant hopes can only be extravagant hopes after all, and now he can only face the cold reality. Fortunately, although this reality is cold, there is still Hua Nongying's fiery body to soothe her.
However, he discovered something bad the next day.
Hua Nongying is missing!
"Master, the fairy went out to do something. This is what she left for the master."
Li Hanshan asked two maids and learned about Hua Nongying's movements and got a note.
He unfolded the note and there were a few lines of beautiful words written on it:
"Master: I see that you are sleeping soundly, and I can't bear to wake you up. I'm here to find some elixirs for prolonging life and strengthening the body for the master, and also make some preparations for my own foundation. Master, don't worry, I will come back as soon as I leave. By the way, when the slave is away, the master should try not to wander around. There are some guys in the sect who don't follow the rules very much. - Make a picture. Stay."
After Li Hanshan finished reading the words, his face darkened. He had a hunch that Hua Nongying would not be back in a short time.
A full seven days passed and she didn't come back.
"This witch is so cunning!"
Li Hanshan frowned, and Hua Nongying's move left him a little puzzled.
Because leaving like this doesn't count as breaking the inner demon's oath.
After she left, he could no longer use her to improve his cultivation. At the same time, Hua Nongying could avoid being sucked and use other means to build his foundation.
And once she builds the foundation and is no longer bound by the inner demon's oath, that will be Li Hanshan's real end.
"No, we can't wait like this."
Li Hanshan decided to do something and couldn't wait here to die.
Fortunately, after he killed the demon girl, he took possession of her spiritual stones and other cultivation resources. Later, in order to appease her, Li Hanshan returned most of it to her, but he still kept a lot. These were still on him, packed in a storage bag.
Li Hanshan packed up all the cultivation resources, asked the maid for some food, then went straight out the door and walked out along a path.
"The inner sect lives on the mountain, and the outer sect lives at the bottom of the mountain. If I keep walking like this, I should be able to reach the area where the outer sect disciples are, and then find a suitable witch to practice."
This is his plan.
It is unrealistic to practice on your own, and it is impossible to catch up with Hua Nongying.
The only solution now is to find another demon girl and then use the Yang Book to practice.
It's just that the candidate for this witch must be well chosen, and her cultivation level cannot be too high, otherwise she may escape control and even expose her secrets.
As for escaping from the Hehuan Sect, he was still not considering it. With Lu Ding's identity here, he couldn't even pass the mountain-protecting formation, so how could he escape?
The Hehuan Sect was huge, and Li Hanshan walked for almost half an hour before reaching an open place. The view ahead suddenly opened up, and you could see rows of buildings built along the mountain. That should be the area where the outer disciples lived.
"That's where the market should be."
Li Hanshan saw a bustling sect market among the many buildings. After thinking about it, he decided to go to the market to have a try. So we walked down the road to the foot of the mountain. As soon as we entered the market, our eyes suddenly became lively.
"Eh? Look at that old man -"
"Isn't that the Innate Pure Yang Holy Body on the black market? And it's not dead yet?"
"No way?When did Senior Sister Hua become so gentle? Didn't the longest of her previous furnaces last only three days? "
Several witches in cool clothes gathered together and pointed at Li Hanshan.
Another charming woman among them rolled her eyes when she heard the words "Innate Pure Yang Holy Body", twisted her waist and walked towards Li Hanshan.
"This old man~" the charming woman said sweetly, "Why are you here alone? Why don't you go with your sister? Sister, I promise to make you comfortable~"
As she spoke, she stretched out her slender fingers to hook Li Hanshan's chin.
Li Hanshan looked down at the finger, silently sensing the other person's breath.
Although this enchantress has some talent, she is far from Hua Nongying. After experiencing Hua Nongying's level of enchantment, looking at this kind of thing is simply boring. But if he could cultivate with the help of her, he could still endure it.
"Don't make trouble! "
A woman in green clothes next to her hurriedly grabbed her and lowered her voice: "Are you crazy? Do you dare to touch Senior Sister Hua Nongying’s furnace? Don't want to die? "
When the charming woman heard the words "Hua Nongying", her face turned pale, she quickly retracted her hand, glanced at Li Hanshan with a disdainful look, and turned around to leave.
"Hua Nongying's name is so scary? "
Li Hanshan's face darkened. If this was the case, then things would be difficult to handle. Because none of these outer disciples dared to touch Hua Nongying’s furnace! Those who dare to touch are too dangerous for him.
He was not discouraged and continued walking in the market.
There are quite a few witches who recognize him. After all, a hundred-year-old old man is quite rare in the Hehuan Sect. This area is also an outer sect area, and many witches have seen him in the underground black market.
In addition to the charming woman at the beginning, there were also other seductresses who came to flirt with him, but they all left wisely after learning that he was Hua Nongying's furnace.
"Why isn't there anyone bolder? I am an innate pure Yang holy body. I can overwhelm the brave to death and starve to death the timid. Do you not understand this? "
Li Hanshan was speechless.
Turning around, it was getting dark, and there were fewer people in the market.
“Senior Brother Sun, don’t do this. "
"Being my Taoist companion is a great blessing for you. I am helping you. Otherwise, in ten days, you will be reduced to a furnace. By then, I will buy you again, and your attitude will not be the same now! "
There was a quarrel.
Li Hanshan followed the sound and saw several young disciples standing in a circle, with a little girl wearing Hehuan Sect disciple uniform standing in the middle.
She tried many times but couldn't get out. Her little face turned red and she was anxious and angry.
"Xu Lingxi? "Li Hanshan was stunned for a moment.
Xu Lingxi was from the same village as him, and this child was kind-hearted. After Li Hanshan crossed over, he often lacked food and clothing, and thanks to their family's support, otherwise he might not be alive now.
It seems that this time the Hehuan Sect arrested people, and even she was not spared.
"Senior Brother Sun, please let me go..." Xu Lingxi was about to cry.
"Junior sister Xu, I have said all the good things to you, but you still don't know how to show me a favor, so you are forcing me to take action. "
Senior Brother Sun was impatient and wanted to catch Xu Lingxi.
"Stop! "
An old voice sounded from the side.
Senior Brother Sun was stunned and turned to look.
I saw an old man with gray beard and hair walking slowly over. His back was slightly stooped, his face was wrinkled, but his eyes were astonishingly bright. "Where did this old thing come from? "
Sun Zeshang looked at Li Hanshan and sneered, "You're an old man and you still want to imitate other heroes to save the beautiful? Get out of here! "
Li Hanshan was neither annoyed nor angry, and said calmly: "She doesn't want to be with you, so why force her to make things difficult for her? "
"Oh? Sun Ze was happy and looked back at the two followers, "Brothers, did you hear that?" How dare this old guy interfere with my business? "
